mapper.select: SELECT id, kb_id AS "kbId", file_name AS "fileName", file_type AS "fileType", file_size AS "fileSize", object_key AS "objectKey", object_etag AS "objectEtag", last_scanned_at AS "lastScannedAt", version, parse_status AS "parseStatus", chunk_status AS "chunkStatus", chunk_count AS "chunkCount", error_msg AS "errorMsg", created_at AS "createdAt", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM kb_document WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE

SELECT id, kb_id AS "kbId", file_name AS "fileName", file_type AS "fileType", file_size AS "fileSize", object_key AS "objectKey", object_etag AS "objectEtag", last_scanned_at AS "lastScannedAt", version, parse_status AS "parseStatus", chunk_status AS "chunkStatus", chunk_count AS "chunkCount", error_msg AS "errorMsg", created_at AS "createdAt", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM kb_document WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_document(kb_id, file_name, file_type, file_size, object_key, object_etag, uploader_id) VALUES(#{kbId}, #{fileName}, #{fileType}, #{fileSize}, #{objectKey}, #{objectEtag}, #{uploaderId})
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_document SET parse_status = #{parseStatus}, chunk_status = #{chunkStatus}, chunk_count = #{chunkCount}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE kb_document SET object_etag = #{etag}, file_size = #{size}, last_scanned_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND object_etag IS NULL AND deleted = FALSE

UPDATE kb_document SET object_etag = #{etag}, file_size = #{size}, version = version + 1, parse_status = 'PENDING', chunk_status = 'PENDING', chunk_count = 0, error_msg = NULL, last_scanned_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE AND (object_etag IS DISTINCT FROM #{etag} OR file_size IS DISTINCT FROM #{size})
UPDATE kb_document SET last_scanned_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_index_task(doc_id, document_version, operation, status, attempts, next_retry_at, updated_at) VALUES(#{docId}, #{version}, #{operation}, 'PENDING', 0, NOW(), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (doc_id, document_version, operation) DO UPDATE SET status = CASE WHEN kb_index_task.status IN ('SUCCESS', 'RUNNING') THEN kb_index_task.status ELSE 'PENDING' END, next_retry_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW(), last_error = NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_index_task SET status = #{status}, last_error = #{error}, attempts = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'RUNNING' THEN attempts + 1 ELSE attempts END, updated_at = NOW(), next_retry_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'FAILED' THEN NOW() + INTERVAL '5 minutes' ELSE NOW() END WHERE doc_id = #{docId} AND document_version = #{version} AND operation = #{operation}

UPDATE kb_index_task SET status = 'PENDING', updated_at = NOW(), next_retry_at = NOW(), last_error = COALESCE(last_error, '服务重启或任务超时，已自动恢复') WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND updated_at < NOW() - (#{timeoutMinutes} || ' minutes')::interval
mapper.select: SELECT t.doc_id AS "docId", t.document_version AS "version", d.kb_id AS "kbId", d.object_key AS "objectKey" FROM kb_index_task t JOIN kb_document d ON d.id = t.doc_id AND d.deleted = FALSE WHERE t.operation = 'UPSERT' AND t.status = 'PENDING' AND t.next_retry_at <= NOW() AND d.chunk_status <> 'INDEXED' ORDER BY t.next_retry_at, t.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_document SET deleted = TRUE, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
